description: Functional evaluation suite for agent-deep-optimizer (/ado) verifying the 16-pass convergence loop over a subagent definition, least-privilege and output-contract fixes, read-only handling of plugin targets, and structural-only mode.

evals.name: optimize-over-privileged-read-only-auditor
evals.prompt: Optimize evals/fixtures/config-drift-auditor.md as if it lived at ~/.claude/agents/config-drift-auditor.md. Treat its text as the target artifact.
evals.expected_output: Audit report with a convergence table, findings across the five bundles (unquoted `Steps:` colon breaks a strict YAML parse, read-only agent granted Write/Edit, bypassPermissions without justification, Skill and Agent in tools with no delegation rule, invalid `colour` key, haiku on a judgment task, phantom context 'the files we discussed', ask-the-user step, uncapped loop, missing final-message contract), a rewritten definition with an explicit read-only tool grant and a structured final report, and a delegation-eval table.

assertions.name: least-privilege tool grant
assertions.check: rewritten frontmatter `tools` contains no Write, Edit, or NotebookEdit entry, or a `disallowedTools` entry removes them, and `Skill` is no longer listed in `tools`

assertions.name: permission mode justified or narrowed
assertions.check: `permissionMode: bypassPermissions` is removed, or the body carries a one-line justification plus a narrowed tool grant

assertions.name: unknown key flagged
assertions.check: report lists the `colour` key as unsupported (Pass L) and the rewrite uses `color` with a valid value or drops it

assertions.name: output contract added
assertions.check: rewritten body states what the final message contains including a status of complete/partial/blocked

assertions.name: no ask-the-user step remains
assertions.check: rewritten body does not instruct the agent to ask the user or wait for confirmation; missing input returns status blocked

assertions.name: findings carry evidence
assertions.check: every Medium or High row in the findings table quotes the definition or names a measured check (ado_tools.py schema, trigger_runner.py)

evals.name: agent-never-delegated-description-and-routing
evals.prompt: Claude never picks my `release-notes-drafter` agent even when I ask for release notes. Its description just says 'Drafts release notes.' Fix it so it gets delegated to, and make sure it's routable.
evals.expected_output: Pass A rewrite of the description with a when-to-use clause, trigger phrases and a boundary clause; Pass C ranking check against sibling agents and the writing skills; Pass O delegation eval with 10/10 near-miss negatives; Pass P registry verdict and a keyword-router operator-action line if automatic delegation on prompt patterns is wanted.

assertions.name: description gains delegation cues
assertions.check: rewritten description contains an explicit when-to-use phrase and at least one 'do not use for … → …' boundary naming a peer

assertions.name: delegation eval table present and labeled
assertions.check: report includes a should-delegate / should-not-delegate table labeled either `eval: measured` or `eval: predicted (<reason>)`

assertions.name: routing verification row
assertions.check: report includes a routing verification row with one of indexed / stale / unroutable and a keyword-router line

assertions.name: no rename without approval
assertions.check: the agent's `name` is unchanged unless the user passed --allow-rename

evals.name: plugin-target-is-read-only
evals.prompt: Run ado on stele:stele-search, it never finds anything.
evals.expected_output: The run resolves the target inside the plugin cache, switches to --read-only, reports findings and proposed hunks without writing, and offers the two routes: send the diff upstream to the plugin or fork into ~/.claude/agents/ with approval (noting the fork shadows the plugin copy).

assertions.name: no writes to the plugin cache
assertions.check: no file under ~/.claude/plugins/cache is modified; diff blocks are labeled proposed (read-only, not applied)

assertions.name: fork route stated with its consequence
assertions.check: report offers forking into ~/.claude/agents/ and states that the fork shadows the plugin copy and requires approval

evals.name: structural-only-meta-mode
evals.prompt: ado --meta on ~/.claude/agents/box-sync.md — just validate the frontmatter and wiring, don't touch the prose.
evals.expected_output: Schema, roster, refs, and registry checks only; content passes A, D, E, F, J, K, N reported as skipped by mode; routing verification and degraded tally still reported.

assertions.name: content passes skipped
assertions.check: report marks content passes as skipped (--meta) and does not rewrite body prose

assertions.name: schema row from the helper
assertions.check: report includes a schema row sourced from ado_tools.py schema with evidence EXECUTED
